crossRefs.note: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever…
A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth…

translations.web: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
translations.bsb: She does not consider the path of life; she does not know that her ways are unstable.
translations.kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know
translations.asv: So that she findeth not the level path of life: Her ways are unstable, and she knoweth it not.
